{{Top}}
{{Youmay|the general title|a [[Captain (disambiguation)|specific rank or position]]}}
[[File:Imperial_Officer_TCG-CS.png|thumb|right|250px|A naval captain of the Galactic Empire]]
{{Quote|Rex, you're enjoying this&hellip;''"<br />"''Me, Sir? Never sir.''"<br />"''We're both captains, Rex&hellip; it's Gil. Drop the ''sir''.''"<br />"''Navy captain outranks army captain, sir. Strictly speaking.''"<br />"''Shut up, for goodness' sake, man, and come have a drink.|Captain [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]] discussing their ranks|<ref name="The Clone Wars: No Prisoners">''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]''</ref>}}
The title or rank of '''captain''' was often used in military organizations and some civilian contexts, and typically indicated an individual with leadership responsibilities.

==Description==
===Surface forces===
[[File:Rebel_Army_Captain.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A [[Alliance Army/Legends|Rebel Army]] captain]]
In ground-based military organizations, captains were typically [[Company/Legends|company]] commanders, a role they served in both the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] (GAR) during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref> and in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In the Imperial forces, they could also serve as support officers, adjutants and aides-de-camp at [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]]'' level or above.<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> At least one officer, [[Captain-Supervisor]]'' [[Grammel]], held a rank which apparently combined his military rank with the civilian bureaucratic title of [[Supervisor/Legends|Supervisor]].<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref>

This rank was in use in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Sith Wars/Legends|Sith Wars]].<ref name="SWTORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

Early in the Clone Wars, clone captains in the GAR were identified by red markings on their armor, while Imperial Army captains seem to have typically worn an insignia with three red pips over three blue, and one code cylinder at the left shoulder,<ref name="To The Last Man">''[[Star Wars: Empire: To the Last Man]]''</ref> although it seems that in some situations, other variations were known: for instance, a [[Death Star Technical Companion|Rebel source]] indicates that some Army captains aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] may have worn a rank bar with a single strip of three pips, and one rank cylinder at either shoulder.<ref name="Death Star Technical Companion">''[[Death Star Technical Companion]]''</ref>

Captains ranked above the [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]] who commanded [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]], and below the [[Major/Legends|majors]] who typically led [[Battalion/Legends|battalions]], in the GAR,<ref name="Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic" /> and also in the Imperial Army.<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook" /> However, in at least some sections of the Imperial military, an extra grade of [[Commander/Legends|commander]] appeared immediately above captain.<ref name="To The Last Man" />

Other militaries were probably broadly similar in their positioning of captain within the chain of command, but the available evidence is not always specific.

===Starfighter forces===
[[File:Soontir_Fel_TIE_Interceptor_Squadron_SWA.png|thumb|right|250px|Captain Soontir Fel disembarks from his TIE Interceptor]]
Most [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] corps followed army-style systems in their rank structure, but this did not always translate into giving officers of the same rank similar responsibilities. In the Rebel Alliance, the rank of Captain, depending on the time period, either occurred between [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] (such being the case pre&ndash;[[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]])<ref name="X-wing">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]</ref> or between Lieutenant and [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] (post&ndash;Battle of Hoth).<ref name="Alliance">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref> The design of the rank likewise depended on the time period. Pre&ndash;Battle of Hoth, it was a silver patch that had three yellow bumps placed in a way that resembled an upside-down triangle.<ref name="X-wing" /> Post&ndash;Battle of Hoth, the rank possessed gold-trim borders and had two red bumps, one being at the topmost-center, and the other being on the bottommost-center,<ref name="Alliance" /> similar to the earlier design of the rank of Captain pre&ndash;Battle of Hoth.<ref name="X-wing" /> In the Imperial military and some early [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] formations, a captain like [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] or [[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken]] often led a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of twelve starfighters,<ref name="Wedge's Gamble">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]'', [[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 25|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 25]]</ref> but by the outbreak of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|Yuuzhan Vong invasion]], a mere [[Flight group/Legends|flight]] of four fighters in New Republic Starfighter Command could be commanded by a higher-ranking [[Major/Legends|Major]], and captains could serve as merely mid-ranking flight officers with no command responsibility.<ref name="Dark Tide: Onslaught">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]''</ref>

===Naval forces===
In naval terminology, "captain" could be a specific rank, but also a title held irrespective of rank. Any military officer with a specific commission to command a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] might be styled as captain.

Within the chain of command, a specific rank of captain was found in most naval forces, although the exact significance of the rank varied.

In many naval services, the rank of captain indicated a command-grade officer analogous to an army [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]], above commander but below [[Commodore/Legends|commodore]]; this was the situation in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], and [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]],<ref name="The Swarm War">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref> and probably in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and New Republic before them. Typically, officers holding the rank of captain would hold the command of a single warship, but some captains were responsible for entire squadrons of capital ships, and not all warships were commanded by officers holding the substantive rank of captain.

[[File:Imp_Captain_SWGTCG.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A captain in the Imperial Navy]]
For example, in the last years of the Old Republic, [[Lorth Needa/Legends|Lorth Needa]] commanded the [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruiser]] RSS [[Integrity (Carrack-class)/Legends|''Integrity'']] as a [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]],<ref name="Revenge of the Sith (novel)">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> while the six [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|Dreadnaught Cruisers]] of [[Outbound Flight]] were each under a commander, with a single captain in overall command.<ref name="Outbound Flight">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref> Similarly, it seems that the captain in command of the [[Rendili Home Defense Fleet]]'s flagship was a senior officer with extensive command authority.<ref name="The Dreadnaughts of Rendili">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Dreadnaughts of Rendili]]''</ref> Occasionally, a captain could serve in a subordinate role: for instance, Captain [[Theb Tobbra]] was first officer of the New Republic heavy cruiser [[Indomitable (Majestic-class)|''Indomitable'']] during the [[Black Fleet Crisis|Koornacht Crisis]], with Commodore [[Turk Brand|Brand]]'' apparently serving as the ship's captain,<ref name="Tyrant's Test 1">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref> although he was also overall commander of [[Task Force Aster]].<ref name="Shield of Lies">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref>

In the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], a rank of [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Captain of the Line]] existed, which was typically held by officers commanding a ''line'', a formation that normally consisted of around four ships but could range in reality from one to twenty, depending on size and role; the rank was also typically held by [[Admiral/Legends|admirals]]' adjutants. This was separate from the title of captain held by the commanding officer of any individual ship,<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook" /> but it may still have corresponded to the traditional rank of captain.

There was a great deal of prestige attached to the post of ship's captain in the Imperial fleet, and the ethos of the Navy honored men who prized and cultivated their relationship with a specific ship: captains might often refuse promotions to administrative posts, or even turn down the command of larger and more capable warships.<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook" />

===Civilian use===
[[File:Captain_Gideon_LoNH_by_David_Kegg.png|thumb|right|180px|A [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], Captain [[Gideon (Devaronian)|Gideon]]]]
Civilians in command of a private vessel, even a light freighter such as the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], were also addressed as "captain."<ref name="A New Hope">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

From the early days of the Galactic Republic, the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]], or "BoSS," was responsible for the licensing, certification, and registration of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] captains. In order to be licensed, a civilian captain during the Imperial era needed to pass numerous oral, written, and practical tests. They also needed a standard background check, documentation of at least ten years as a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]], and a 300-[[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] fee. The fee was increased to 500 credits to expedite licensing, which eliminated much of the testing and flight-time requirements. Many [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] operated with forged documents, however, which cost thousands of credits but avoided other legal entanglements.<ref name="Platt's Smugglers Guide">''[[Platt's Smugglers Guide]]''</ref>

Captain's licenses were required to legally buy a starship, obtain an arms load-out permit for a starship, or obtain copies of the ''[[Spacer's Information Manual]]'' from the Imperial [[Imperial Space Ministry/Legends|Space Ministry]]. Operating a starship without a captain's license was a [[Class Four Infraction]] under the [[Imperial Penal Code/Legends|Imperial Penal Code]].<ref name="Platt's Smugglers Guide" />

The rank of captain was also used by [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law-enforcement agencies]] and usually referred to a high-ranking officer in the organization.<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref> Sports teams such as [[Limmie/Legends|limmie]] teams also had captains.<ref name="Holo">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|sports/13314_1.html|Coruscant Eliminated in Galactic Cup Opening Round}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The "Retired Imperial Captain" was one of the original twenty-four character templates used by the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'', first published in the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|first edition rulebook]].<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
